about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
about.head: feb04ec

name: v1.4.204
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(native-chat): wait for the runtime capability probe before resolving the creation launch route by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19819
* fix(worktrees): retire the chat tab of a chat with no child when its workspace goes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19970
* feat(ai-vault-search): public session search contract and transports by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20277
* refactor(mobile): migrate settings reads to RpcOperation by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20499
* fix(mobile): give native chat one tail-follow owner so streaming stops jumping by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20493
* fix(mobile): preserve delivery ambiguity across transport cutover by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20280
* fix(runtime): reject malformed file Base64 padding by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20283
* fix(tasks): preserve repository results under GitHub search quota by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20460
* fix(ai-vault): stream oversized remote session transcripts by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20455
* fix(grok): stop replayed Claude/Cursor hooks reporting Grok panes as Claude by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20507
* fix(browser): press keys through a US-layout CDP key table instead of a subprocess per keystroke by @atreidesend in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15310
* fix(rpc): validate provider-specific fields in TaskProviderIdentity by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20284
* perf(terminal): batch file-link checks on their owning host by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20463
* feat(native-chat): support file drag and drop by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20494
* fix: show unexpected signout notice only once across versions by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20526
* test(mobile): consolidate the RPC migration's verification infrastructure by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20521
* refactor(attention): move the agent attention boundary off terminal panes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20525
* fix(grok): defer managed hook pane guard expansion to shell by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20534
* fix(auth): report callback failures instead of cancellation by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20535
* perf(skills): bound WSL installed skill discovery by @PPP-JH in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/12314
* fix(git): skip upstream remote probes when the remote is absent by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18455
* refactor(orchestration): derive delivery eligibility from messages by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19837
* fix(ssh): bound relay incumbent lsof probe by @kaluli123123 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18304
* perf(remote): avoid repeated capability probes during file imports by @dngur6344 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14555
* fix(grok): announce a completion once, when Grok is actually finished by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20523
* feat(native-chat): add provider-aware Fast mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20506
* fix(claude): subscribe to SessionEnd on capable versions, and correct a false comment by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20530
* refactor(mobile): send the source-control domain through typed RpcOperations by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20544
* perf(persistence): skip redundant whole-state flushes on terminal reattach by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20137
* feat(agent-status): run-identity types for keying rows by agent instead of pane by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20531
* fix(hooks): report a timed-out hook as unverifiable and terminate its process tree by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20559
* fix(terminal): drop the agent gutter from copied selections (#19770) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20545
* fix(session-search): read oversized numeric file IDs on Windows by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20551
* fix(workspaces): re-seed a gate-reported empty workspace after an agent selection by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20182
* fix(workspaces): recover a real terminal when activation throws for a planless agent create by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20190
* feat(native-chat): show a drop target on the whole chat pane by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20561
* fix(native-chat): let the provider reopen a Claude turn it resumed itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20518
* fix(native-chat): resume structured chats cleanly after restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20509
* fix(github): name an unfiltered empty project view instead of blaming a filter by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20588
* fix(ai-vault): ignore non-absolute env overrides for agent scan roots by @manuaudio in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/13118
* fix(grok): stop SessionStart orca-status hook hanging for 10s by @bjornrun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20090
* perf(browser): dispatch coordinate pointer input in process instead of one subprocess per event by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20593
* fix(pty): pace the EAGAIN write retry so a stalled reader can't saturate the daemon thread by @nireak in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15319
* fix(mobile): two known main bugs the RPC migration preserved by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20563
* test(mobile): pin each RPC golden to its own scenario input, not the whole manifest by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20562
* fix(native-chat): stop a bounded tail read from moving the chat cursor past unapplied rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20581
* refactor(mobile): send the task workspace-creation domain through typed RpcOperations by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20568
* feat(ai-vault-search): construct the session search indexer in the scanner service behind a setting by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20516
* fix(native-chat): hide activity while awaiting input by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20496

## New Contributors
* @atreidesend made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15310
* @PPP-JH made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/12314
* @manuaudio made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/13118
* @bjornrun made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20090
* @nireak made their first contribution in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15319

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.203...v1.4.204
